    The quiver of a residue category P/μ #

    For a nonzero morphism μ of a finite ray category that is neither invertible nor irreducible, no irreducible morphism factors through μ, so the residue functor P ⥤ P/μ sends irreducible morphisms to irreducible morphisms. This gives a morphism of quivers RayVert P ⥤q RayVert (P/μ) (RayCat.residueQuiverMap) compatible with values of paths (pathVal_mapPath). Input for part (a) of the lemma in Section 3.1 of Bongartz, Indecomposables live in all smaller lengths.
